pages.text: Pipo had never watched a sunrise from the start. Today, he woke while it was dark.
"I will watch the sunrise from the hill." As he entered the yard, Grandpa Sheep already stood at the gate.
Grandpa pointed up the hill with his stick. "There is a spot that has always been perfect for sunrise. Follow me."
He led Pipo under a big tree. "Sunrise looks best from here."
The sky brightened. However Pipo craned his head, the big tree hid the sun.
"This tree used to be only this big." Grandpa held a hand at knee height.
Only little bits of light slipped between the leaves. Pipo stamped impatiently. The whole sunrise would be over!
Pipo ran toward the stone wall. Nothing blocked the view above it.
He hopped onto the low wall. The view beyond the hill was wide open.
The sun floated above the hill. Grandpa came and sat beside him. "Really, I might as well have found this spot for you."
